title: New life i´m in - BERNARD ALLISON

lines.l: The time has come and gone
I don't think I should be alone
I've hurt so many people
The time has come to make amends
It was hard to admit I was wrong
And so hard to make them into a friend
Be careful what you think
Be careful what you do
The time has come to tell the truth
Now I feel much better, babe
You know I'm tired of playing a silly game
I know I hurt you so bad
I've accepted all the guilt and shame
It's been a long time coming
I was sure it was the end
I wanna thank you, Lord, for the new life I need
I want to thank you, Lord
For the new life I made
I want to thank you, thank you for the new life I made
I want to thank you, thank you
